title: rcac-bioinformatics/mitoforge pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the samplesheet provided with --input

sample.errorMessage: Column 'sample': a sample name is required and must not contain spaces.

platform.errorMessage: Column 'platform': must be exactly 'hifi' (PacBio HiFi reads) or 'illumina' (paired-end short reads).

fastq_1.errorMessage: Column 'fastq_1': must be an existing read file ending in .fa/.fasta/.fna/.fq/.fastq, optionally gzipped, with no spaces in the path.

fastq_2.errorMessage: Column 'fastq_2': must be an existing read file ending in .fa/.fasta/.fna/.fq/.fastq, optionally gzipped, with no spaces in the path.

bam.errorMessage: Column 'bam': must be an existing PacBio unaligned BAM file ending in .bam, with no spaces in the path.

species.errorMessage: Column 'species': must be a scientific name such as 'Deilephila porcellus'. Used to look up a reference mitogenome at NCBI.

ref_fa.errorMessage: Column 'ref_fa': must be either a path to a reference mitogenome FASTA (.fa/.fasta/.fna, optionally gzipped) or the string 'hifi:<sample>' naming a hifi sample in this samplesheet whose finalised mitogenome should be used.

ref_gb.errorMessage: Column 'ref_gb': must be a path to the GenBank flat file (.gb/.gbk/.gbff/.genbank) matching ref_fa.

genetic_code.errorMessage: Column 'genetic_code': must be an NCBI translation table number. Common animal choices: 2 = vertebrate mitochondrial (default), 5 = invertebrate mitochondrial, 9 = echinoderm and flatworm mitochondrial.
